title: IAM's Law Sphere in the chain; each type's measured healthy level documented; every sequencing instrument has a planted-answer test
set_out: Sign off every sequencing instrument on spent atlas libraries; build IAM's Law Sphere into the chain; document the measured substitute for each type's level; apply the 2026-11-07 healthy-reference rule; set held-out bars for Met-A on sequencing and the territories.
open_at_turnover: The 49 never-used libraries reread through the current chain and the pooling test on 12 of them; the known-answer run after the run-length and intake fix; the render check of the report; bars for Met-A, the territories and the ceiling distance once the 6 % offset is settled.

sections.heading: What ran, and how each came out

entries.title: IAM's Law Sphere in the one button (DEV-SPHERE-01, PHY-035)
entries.what: The sample's own molecules read against IAM's Law, with an input card, saved counts, sweep and fit.
entries.outcome: Runs on every sequencing file; the card's synthetic found the counter counts isolated losses, so the level layers convert.

entries.title: Each type's measured healthy level and the hold alarm (DEV-IAMA-BAND-01)
entries.what: Held error against IAM-A's own line times each type's level measured from the atlas's healthy libraries.
entries.outcome: 40 of 41 unseen libraries within two standard uncertainties; documented with its data and summary files.

entries.title: Held-out pass 8 (GRP-019, GRP-017)
entries.what: All 137 atlas inputs read against the other donor half, every in-mix reading.
entries.outcome: Middles at 1 (Met-A whole 0.990); widths large; recorded as measured widths, not bands.

entries.title: Planted-fault test set on the test library
entries.what: Six reads of GSM5652214, one known fault each, through the one button.
entries.outcome: Each fault moved its own instrument; run excess by length and an intake refusal added (0f17bb26).

entries.title: Known-answer run after the reference edits
entries.what: The test library read again, field by field against its known answer.

entries.title: OTH-064: WHY_IAM.md retired; its testing rules moved to the test design checklist
entries.what: The public WHY_IAM.md retired (the author keeps it privately); its testing rules moved verbatim to CANON/TEST_DESIGN_CHECKLIST.md.
entries.outcome: On main (d01b3713); home page link removed.

entries.title: OTH-086: The author's testing checklist and machine rules in the test design checklist
entries.what: The author's testing checklist, testing plan template, methods and Google machine rules published in the test design checklist.

sections.heading: What we learned that we did not know yesterday

entries.title: The 6 % offset is the whole-sample route, not the libraries
entries.what: On the 49 never-used libraries sorted-cell Met-A reads 1.017 and whole-sample Met-A 0.930, low in 19 of 24 types.
entries.outcome: Leading explanation written before the test: a pooled-donor expectation overstates an unseen person's disorder.

sections.heading: Our own mistakes and what caught them

entries.title: Half-atlas columns one CpG off
entries.what: The agent built the half-only atlas columns one CpG off, invalidating two canaries.
entries.outcome: Caught by checking against the published donor halves; corrected in public (3bf03e97).
